business_summary: Fullshare Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells mechanical transmission equipment and gear products in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Europe, Australia, and internationally. It operates in five segments: Properties; Tourism; Investment and Financial Services; Healthcare, Education, and Others; and New Energy. The Properties segment invests in, develops, and sells properties, including shopping malls, carparks, and commercial properties; and provides construction related services. The Tourism segment operates hotels and resorts; and sells tourist goods, as well as provides related services. The Investment and Financial Services segment holds and invests in various investments and financial products, such as listed and unlisted securities, bonds, funds, derivatives, structured, and other treasury products; and offers investment and financial related consulting services which include corporate finance, investment management, equity capital markets, and money lending services to listed companies, high net-worth individuals, and institutional and corporate clients. The Healthcare, Education, and Others segment sells healthcare, education, and other products, as well as provides related services. The New Energy segment manufactures and sells mechanical transmission equipment products, such as wind, industrial, and rail transportation gear transmission equipment products. This segment is also involved in the trading of goods. It also manufactures and sells gear box and fittings products. The company was formerly known as Warderly International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Fullshare Holdings Limited in October 2014. Fullshare Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Fullshare Holdings Limited는 중국, 미국, 유럽, 호주 및 국제적으로 기계 변속기 장비 및 기어 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이는 다섯 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다: 속성; 관광 여행; 투자 및 금융 서비스; 의료, 교육 및 기타; 그리고 새로운 에너지. 부동산 부문은 쇼핑몰, 주차장, 상업용 부동산을 포함한 부동산에 투자, 개발 및 판매합니다. 건설 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 관광 부문은 호텔과 리조트를 운영합니다. 관광 상품 판매 및 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 투자 및 금융 서비스 부문은 상장 및 비상장 증권, 채권, 펀드, 파생 상품, 구조화 및 기타 국채 상품과 같은 다양한 투자 및 금융 상품을 보유하고 투자합니다. 상장회사, 고액자산가, 기관 및 기업 고객을 대상으로 기업금융, 투자관리, 자기자본시장, 자금대출 서비스 등 투자 및 금융 관련 컨설팅 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 의료, 교육 및 기타 부문은 의료, 교육을 판매합니다.
